recent_commits.message: This CL modifies the MLIR MemoryEffects for RecordEventMetricForTensor from Write to Read. Modeling the side effect as a strict global Write serialization bottlenecked the XLA compiler per step resulting in dense sequential host-callbacks dropping trainer speed. Easing this restriction to a Read prevents aggressive XLA queueing while retaining the operation from DCE.
